metadata.data_discrepancy_note: IMF DataMapper screenshot shows 2025 selection ID 5.08k vs VN 4.83k, while WB 2025 actual is VN 5.066 vs ID 5.060 and IMF 2026 projection is VN 5.259 vs ID 5.153. Script keeps the 2026 projection with PROYEKSI label; screenshot used only as context in S2 beat 2.
metadata.fx_reference_note: Screenshots show IDR ~18.252-18.268/USD (Nov 2026) and projections to 18.800. Narration keeps Rp18.000 as Katadata assumption (audio already rendered); screenshot used as context for S4 beat 1.
